verdict.rationale: Airwallex provides the event side of event-driven automation: real-time webhooks with stable event IDs, retry and re-delivery semantics, and delivery-status inspection. Building the actions requires your own code, the CLI ('wire Airwallex into automated systems'), or AgentOS skills and workflows. The evidence never shows a native rule builder where users define 'when X happens, do Y' without writing their own handler. Missing for 10: native user-defined rule/trigger engine, no-code event-to-action configuration, documented examples of automated actions firing on events within Airwallex itself.
